title: Selah · The Word that remains
description: Selah turns your church's Sunday sermon into a short study for each day of the week: a passage, a reflection and a prayer.
hero_heading: God makes Himself known in His Word.
verse_text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
hero_lede: Reading the Bible isn't one more task: it's how God speaks to us, corrects us and comforts us. What is preached on Sunday bears fruit when it comes back to us on Monday, on Tuesday and every day.
step1_text: Your church preaches. The sermon is where it starts.
step2_text: Selah turns the sermon into a short study for each day, reviewed by your church's leaders before it's published.
step3_text: You read the passage, reflect and pray. A few minutes that carry you through the week.
glimpse_heading: On your phone and your computer
glimpse_text: One page for each day with the passage, the reflection and the prayer, and your week in rings beside it. Tick off what you've read and pick up where you left off.
alt_laptop: Selah's Today page on a computer: the day's study on a green card, its three parts to tick, the week in rings and upcoming events for an example church.
alt_phone: Selah's Today page on a phone with the day finished: three parts ticked, the day's ring filled green and the line “That's today. Go in peace.”
members_text: Choose your church and start with this week's study. You don't need an account to read.
leaders_text: Selah turns each Sunday sermon into a week of studies. You review everything before it's published, and your church reads it on the web and on their phones.
alt_hero: Before dawn, someone reads an open Bible at a desk by a window overlooking misty mountains.
today_heading: A day you can watch fill up
today_text: Every day has three parts: the reading, a reflection and a prayer. Tick each one as you go. Try it here.
feat1_text: Reading in green, reflection in amber, prayer in dusk blue, each with its own small painting. Tick one and it hops.
feat2_text: Each day's ring fills with what you did, so you see the week at a glance. Forgot to tick yesterday? Tap it and catch up.
feat3_text: Finish the day and the light settles on the card. No streaks, no confetti, nothing to lose: just “Go in peace.”
demo_label: A working copy of Selah's Today page
demo_eyebrow: The Lord is my shepherd · Day 1 of 3
reader_text: In the reader, a small glass bar floats at the bottom. As you scroll, the part you're reading widens, ready to tick, and when all three are done it turns into a way back to Today. Keep scrolling to see it.
reader_quote: Whoever has the Lord as shepherd has what they truly need.
reader_reflection_text: The psalmist doesn't describe a life without trouble, but a life with company. Before asking for anything, he names who guides him. Today we can start the same way: remembering we don't walk alone.
reader_prayer_text: Lord, thank you for your Word. Teach me to listen to you and to follow you today. Amen.
alt_reader: Selah's reader on a phone, scrolling through a day's reading, reflection and prayer, with a floating bar to tick each part.
art_text: Each study and each day gets its own illustration from one hand-painted library, chosen to fit the passage: still waters for Psalm 23, a vine for John 15.
reader_note: The reading opens in an external reader; Selah doesn't store the Bible text.
reader_apply_text: This week, set aside a few minutes each morning to read the passage slowly and write down one sentence you want to remember.
reader_question1: What does this passage tell you about who God is?
reader_question2: What concrete step can you take today?
